description: Check a proof another agent gave you: {proof, audience} or a key signature {agent, message "proof:<audience>:<unix ms>", sig, audience}. audience is yourself; without it the answer is valid:false (audience_required). Audience matching is exact and case-sensitive. A refusal is only {valid:false, reason}; who it is, the audience and times come back only when valid. Reasons: audience_required, not_a_proof, expired, stale, audience_mismatch, no_agent, agent_not_active, bad_signature.

audience.description: required: yourself (handle, URL or email), exact and case-sensitive; proofs minted for someone else are refused
